name: The Midnight Mainframe
description: A vintage mainframe has gone quiet, but several terminals still answer on the lab network. Identify which host holds the archived record and recover its contents. Scan 172.20.0.0/24; challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199.

tasks.name: Recover the archived record
tasks.description: A vintage mainframe has gone quiet, but several terminals still answer on the lab network. Identify which host holds the archived record and recover its contents. Scan 172.20.0.0/24; challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199.
hints: Some services answer in ways that do not match what their port number suggests. Pay attention to the first response you receive.
The mailbox-style greeting and status replies are clues. Try interacting with the service using POP3 commands.
Log in to the archive mailbox, inspect its message list, then retrieve the stored message.
